notes.title: AGEOD special Sales
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Don’t miss out on our special deal on the entire AGEOD games catalog.[/b]

If you haven’t heard yet, on[b] June 4th[/b], we are releasing our new strategic 4X game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34556788/2208a629574e40e2e9d50bc0f2cd4cbab53be7cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Field of Glory: Kingdoms[/b] is the latest game from the award-winning studio AGEOD, known for creating some of the best grand strategy games of all time. Set in 1054, just after the Great Schism, it covers more than two centuries of epic European, African, and Middle Eastern history.

[b]Here's a quick overview of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] 375 factions
[*] 325 units
[*] 600 buildings
[*] 14 religions/heresies
[*] 90 cultural traits (all new)
[/list]

If you want to learn more, follow the game on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985050/Field_of_Glory_Kingdoms/

[url=https://discord.gg/3Xrm3ge5wQ]Join our Discord community[/url]


And don't forget to check out the Dev Diaries:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985050/view/4178854131307887205

notes.title: Slitherine gets an Humble Bundle!
notes.notes:
What have the Middle Ages, the Second World War, Ancient Rome and Hellish demons got in common?

Probably nothing, apart from the fact they are the settings of our games in the [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Weekly Humble Bundle![/url]

Starting today a huge list of Slitherine/Matrix games will be available through the Humble section.

You can [b]name your price for Conquest! Medieval Realms, Frontline: Road to Moscow, Battle Academy, and Rise of Prussia Gold.[/b]

If you wish, you can pay [b]$6 or more to receive Qvadriga and Hell[/b] as well.

And last but not least, [b]for only $10 or more you will receive all of the above plus Close Combat: Gateway to Caen,[/b] the latest release in the critically-acclaimed Close Combat series!

Don’t miss the opportunity to play these amazing games and help a charity at the same time!
